title: No pattern was updated for the props added to fix the consumer reports
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, asked to assess whether the patterns had drifted from the design system
details:
The kit gained `labelOverflow`, `alignLabel`, `scrollSelectedIntoView`, `filterable`, `expandAllControl` and a set of `data-part` hooks, each in response to a closed record here. A grep across `patterns/*.md` for any of those names returns nothing, and nothing under `preview/src/pages/patterns/` has been touched since the repository's first commit.

CONTRIBUTING now lists patterns as the fifth file that moves with a component, and says the visual gate cannot tell whether a pattern still teaches the right composition after a component gains a prop. This is that failure, several times over.

The sharpest instance: CUI-004 was filed by someone whose six-section sidebar grew six filter boxes. `patterns/Explorer.md` still presents independent per-section filters as the multi-section shape and never mentions turning them off.

notes.text: Filed against the patterns rather than reopening the component records, which are closed correctly. The components do what they should; the worked examples have not caught up.
